title: Fix app to viewport height; scroll only the list and detail panes
context: Before this commit, .App and body used min-height:100vh, so the page itself grew and scrolled. Several panes also capped height with vh units: the recordings list at 70vh, the transcript at 60vh, the transcript edit list at 60vh, and the edit textarea at min-height 40vh. The commit body states the goal: the app fills the viewport, the page never scrolls, and the recordings list, transcript, notes and Ask thread scroll inside their panes.
decision: The page is locked to the viewport: html, body and #root are height 100%, body has overflow:hidden, and .App is 100vh/100dvh with overflow:hidden. A flex chain with min-height:0 and flex:1 1 auto runs from the container through the tab panel, the recordings split (.recs), the list pane, and the detail pane (.recs-detail, .recs-item) into the transcript, notes and Ask regions. Each of those regions is the scroll container. RecordingAsk.js wraps the Ask thread and its endRef in a new .ask-scroll div, which becomes the scrolling region. The vh max-heights are removed in favor of flex sizing.
consequences: The page no longer scrolls; scrolling happens only inside the list, transcript, notes, Ask and edit-list regions.
Short panels (#panel-record, #panel-file, .recs-solo) get overflow-y:auto as a safety net, so content that does not fit scrolls inside the panel rather than the page.
On phones at 480px and below, .subtab-panel gets min-height max(320px, 60dvh) so the detail card can scroll the header away and the list keeps a usable height.
The transcript edit textarea changes from min-height 40vh to flex-grown with min-height 120px and resize:none.
The .App outer padding drops from 32px 16px to 16px, and the small-screen padding changes from 12px 8px to 12px 16px.
The 480px-breakpoint rule that set .recs-list max-height:none is removed. The phone list layout is now governed by the flex chain.
The flex chain is fragile: any new wrapper between the viewport and a scroll region must also carry min-height:0 and flex sizing, or it will overflow instead of scrolling.
alternatives_rejected: Fixed vh-based max-heights on the recordings list (70vh), transcript (60vh) and transcript edit list (60vh), plus min-height:100vh on the page, are replaced by flex sizing that fills the remaining viewport height.
